runtime: Offline JavaScript, float32 arrays and Web Workers; no external libraries

architecture.attention: Two independent global queries (44 -> 96), tanh, scaled dot-product softmax over opponent embeddings
architecture.actionSelection: Sample learned BANK probability outside mathematically proven rules. Stable sampled advice per decision state. Original scripted compatibility test retains legacy greedy selection.

exactFeatures.targetRecurrence: h(p) = [6*h(2p) + sum(count[s]*h(p+s))]/36, h(p>=target)=1; bust contribution is zero
exactFeatures.largerTargets: Integer grid lower/upper bounds, approximately 512 cells
exactFeatures.scoreArithmetic: Safe integer Number, then BigInt promotion
ruleOverrides: Two-player strict-lead preservation by public bank matching
Final-round strict-lead shadowing with one active rival

training.algorithm: Neural population PPO with independent explorer and frozen-target challenger
training.reward: Terminal first place 1; k-way first-place tie 1/k; otherwise 0
training.valueTargets: Terminal first-place shares; full-horizon return minus value advantages normalize within each table size over non-forced decisions
training.valueLoss: 0.5 * binary cross entropy; chosen-action auxiliary loss 0.2 * binary cross entropy
training.earlyStop: Sampled PPO KL >0.025 before steps; full-batch Bernoulli KL after epochs stops at 0.01 and restores epoch weights plus optimizer above 0.025
training.selfPlay: Every opponent is a network. 15% all-current tables outside challenger batches. Remaining seats sample frozen neural policies. Main favors measured difficulties; explorer samples uniformly; challenger faces one frozen target.
training.syntheticStates: Random round and independent scores, scale 10^2 to 10^7, same game rules
training.parallelism: Six of eight synchronous batches update the main network; one updates an independent explorer; one updates a specialist challenger. Each learner has its own optimizer. Each batch uses 1/2/4/6 data-parallel workers.
training.storageKey: current-banknet-neural-only-1; existing Bank Net slots retained
training.checkpoint: Main and both specialists with independent optimizers, founder archive, frozen target, champions, histories and resumable benchmark blocks

pairedFeedback.sampling: Uniform reservoir over games, then over non-forced current-policy positions within each selected game; both continuations use neural opponents and proven rules
pairedFeedback.evaluation: Both first actions roll to terminal results using frozen lineup policies, identical future dice addressing and common opponent noise; paired worlds use a marginal-preserving 18-face antithetic shift
pairedFeedback.targets: Both action-value heads receive empirical win-share targets; clipped, shrunken expected-action policy gradient supplements PPO
pairedFeedback.episodeCounter: Counts collected full games only; branch continuations tracked separately

evaluation.cells: Selected player counts x 10/15/20 rounds, half frozen neural reference and half rotating neural challengers
evaluation.reference: Three independently initialized founders plus selected available historical networks, frozen at first neural benchmark
evaluation.comparison: Candidate and incumbent use sampled neural decisions with exact probability inputs and proven rules. Dice, lineups, seats and state-keyed random action draws are paired. Independent fresh fixtures confirm promotions. Original scripted bankbench-46 remains unchanged as a separate deterministic compatibility test.

status: Experimental and initially untrained. Capacity, mathematical and runtime tests do not establish superiority over v3.5.

trainerStability.promotion: paired 95% positive delta on fixed and independent fresh fixtures
trainerStability.regression: Retain protected champion; do not automatically discard current training weights

population.challengerTarget: Frozen main or confirmed neural champion
population.challengerRestart: Alternates transferred main weights and independent random initialization
population.guarantee: No convergence or strength guarantee for multiplayer Bank
